objective: Test whether a causally confirmed external-liquidity raid followed by short-term displacement, true order-block failure, breaker/FVG overlap and first managed retracement has enough repeatable after-cost expectancy to justify exact BBO and funding reconstruction before opening 2024.

trader_explanation.long: Raid confirmed sell-side liquidity; reclaim it; close through a confirmed internal high with displacement; require the last bearish order block to fail and become a bullish breaker; require the displacement FVG to overlap that breaker; buy only the first accepted retracement into the overlap; stop beyond the raid; target already-confirmed buy-side liquidity.
trader_explanation.why_distinct: The setup requires actual order-block failure and conversion into a breaker, exact breaker/FVG intersection, a managed first-retest lifecycle and an opposing-liquidity target. A sweep, engulfing candle or FVG alone is insufficient.

data_contract.integrity: Downloaded gzip/zip bytes, decompressed source hash, row count, first timestamp, last timestamp and gap count are recorded.
data_contract.missing_data: A complete UTC one-minute grid is required. Missing bars remain missing; there is no forward fill, interpolation or timeline compression.

causal_market_structure.external_liquidity: 15-minute pivots with fixed left bars and two or three right-confirmation bars; a pivot is unavailable until the right side has closed.
causal_market_structure.internal_structure: One-minute pivots with two right-confirmation bars.
causal_market_structure.raid: The wick crosses confirmed external liquidity and the completed candle closes back through the level.
causal_market_structure.mss: Within five or ten completed one-minute bars after the raid, a displacement close crosses a previously confirmed opposite internal pivot.
causal_market_structure.displacement: Body size is at least 0.8 or 1.2 times prior-only median ATR.
causal_market_structure.breaker: The last opposite candle in the frozen pre-displacement search window is an order-block candidate only if the displacement close crosses its far edge, proving failure and breaker conversion.
causal_market_structure.fvg: Classic same-direction three-candle fair-value gap ending at the displacement candle.
causal_market_structure.unicorn_zone: Exact price intersection of breaker and FVG; overlap must be at least 25 percent of the smaller component zone.
causal_market_structure.first_retest: Only the first subsequent completed candle touching the overlap may qualify. A rejected first touch permanently invalidates the setup.
causal_market_structure.entry: Next contiguous one-minute open after the accepted first-retest close.
causal_market_structure.stop: Beyond the original raid extreme plus 0.05 prior ATR.
causal_market_structure.target: Nearest opposing external-liquidity pivot that was already confirmed before entry.
causal_market_structure.structural_exit: Next contiguous open after a completed close through the adverse breaker edge.
causal_market_structure.source_gap_after_entry: Terminal account loss; the trade is never deleted or marked at a favorable invented price.

candidate_grid.candidate_id: first 20 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over canonical sorted candidate JSON

account_contract.participation_cap: 0.1 percent of prior completed 60-minute quote turnover proxy
account_contract.funding_proxy: Adverse one-basis-point reserve for each UTC eight-hour funding boundary crossed; exact historical Bybit funding is mandatory before rank eligibility.
account_contract.calendar_day_denominator: Every UTC calendar day in the evaluated year, including zero-trade days.
account_contract.terminal_loss: NAV zero, total return minus 100 percent and maximum drawdown 100 percent.

freeze_rule: Freeze up to eight diverse 2022 survivors before downloading any 2023 market file, prioritizing 18-bps geometric daily growth, exact top-10-percent-removed return, lower drawdown, lower concentration and candidate_id.

conditional_next_stage.zero_development_survivors: Register reusable hard-valid negative evidence and leave 2024 through 2026 sealed.
conditional_next_stage.one_or_more_development_survivors: Freeze representatives, independently reconstruct exact historical Bybit BBO/depth and funding, and only then create a separate sequential 2024 claim.

hard_invalidations: order block called a breaker without a completed close through its far edge
breaker and FVG coexist but do not intersect
later retest accepted after the first touch failed
bar gap filled or timeline compressed
2024 or later data opened by this workflow
